scope: FD-004. Release-binary and portable-browser checks, followed separately by the user-accepted trial results.

release_build.native: Original 1.5.1.0 EXE on WebView2. First direct key and clear to each panel to key passed. Two rapid clicks produced two symbols. Ordinary input and clear retained a constant field and viewport height. Nested fractions grew and cleared back to one line.
release_build.editor_at_560: Source and note retain editing focus, explicit symbol targets the formula, long-press select and cancel, fraction Tab and Tab exit, long formula horizontal scroll, invalid raw LaTeX preservation and help panel scroll.
release_build.portable_browser: Standalone headless Edge opened the HTML extracted from the browser portable ZIP via file URL. Note editing survived a keyboard layout change. Quick symbol presses and Greek input after clearing and selecting a domain passed.

accepted_trial.verified_release_html_delta: Only the displayed footer version changes from 1.5.0 to 1.5.1.
accepted_trial.user_feedback: User confirmed first keyboard input, input after clearing and selecting a panel, and stable clearing.
accepted_trial.native_mouse: The same Windows mouse click activated the original and trial windows. Only the trial received the first symbol. The trial also received a symbol after clear and panel navigation.
accepted_trial.native_geometry: At 100% system scale, simultaneous WebView frame and Win32 window measurements at contiguous ordinary edit and clear showed constant window heights of 517 px at width 400 and 483 px at width 560. Clearing a nested fraction contracted once from 548 to 517 and 514 to 483 px respectively.
accepted_trial.integration: Both copy modes pasted exactly into an independent WinForms textbox. A worksheet was saved and reopened via native file dialogs. The global hotkey hid and showed the same window, and a repeat launch restored the window with its contents.

limits: During actual growth of a tall formula, the page can briefly show a scrollbar while the native host grows.
The 125% and 150% checks changed WebView2 rendering scale only. Windows 10, system DPI changes and mixed-DPI monitor moves were not retested for FD-004.
